input.summary: Remove the USD 25,000 per day Customer-payable liquidated damages and confirm Customer owes no liquidated damages or penalties.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept liquidated damages or penalties payable by us, so we have replaced the USD 25,000 per day dependency-delay charge in Section 7.6 with a confirmation that no liquidated damages or penalties are payable by Customer. Vendor's remedies for a genuine dependency delay remain available as schedule relief and actual damages.

ops.oldText: Customer shall pay Vendor USD 25,000 per day as agreed liquidated damages for any delay in providing a dependency.
ops.newText: Customer shall not be liable for any liquidated damages or penalties under this Agreement.
